about: P68-F T4: 20 English ideas for the first-person rail shooter (railfps). Each names the enemy you shoot and the place you ride through; `enemy` must be a word of the compiled enemy role label and `setting` a part of `theme.setting` after draftFill + compile. s13-s20 are the railfps dev sentences d17-d24 of evals/play/p68/dev.json (tuning on them is allowed); s01-s12 were written for this task before the module was tuned; their first run found two general bugs (s08: 'a shooting gallery at the county fair' read the gallery or the fair as the enemy; s07: the enemy after 'aim at' became the place) and both were fixed in the module, not by rewording. T7 lists them in integration.md.

sentences.text: Zap alien invaders in the space station hallway
look around and shoot the zombies shambling toward you in the abandoned mall
stand on the castle wall and fire arrows at the skeletons climbing up
blast the mutant rats swarming through the sewer tunnels
through your own eyes on a pirate ship, shoot the sea monsters rising from the waves
stand guard in a snowy forest and shoot the wolves running out of the trees
aim at the giant spiders crawling down the walls of the old temple
a shooting gallery at the county fair where you hit the wooden bears before they roll past
riding a hover sled across the frozen lake, zap the ice gremlins chasing you
inside a sunken submarine, shoot the killer sharks before they bite through the hull
turn left and right in the dusty canyon and blast the scorpions crawling at you
ride a lava cart through the volcano and blast the fire imps jumping onto the track
a first-person ride in a mine cart on rails, turning to shoot the bats that swoop at you in the dark tunnels
ride a train through the wild west and shoot the bandits on horseback before they jump aboard
an on-rails shooter on a river boat where you aim at crocodiles leaping out of the swamp
seen through the eyes of a kid on a roller coaster, splat paint balloons at clowns popping up along the track
a ghost train ride through a haunted house where you zap the ghosts flying at your cart with a flashlight
sit in a tour jeep that follows the jungle road on its own and fire at the angry monkeys throwing coconuts at you
a first person rail shooter on a space station monorail, blasting drones before they reach you
ride a log flume through a pirate cove and soak the pirates with a water cannon before they fire at your log
